014package org.microbean.bean;
015
016import java.lang.constant.ClassDesc;
017import java.lang.constant.Constable;
018import java.lang.constant.ConstantDesc;
019import java.lang.constant.DynamicConstantDesc;
020import java.lang.constant.MethodHandleDesc;
021import java.lang.constant.MethodTypeDesc;
022
023import java.util.AbstractList;
024import java.util.Collection;
025import java.util.List;
026import java.util.Optional;
027
028import javax.lang.model.type.TypeMirror;
029
030import org.microbean.assign.SupertypeList;
031
032import org.microbean.constant.Constables;
033
034import org.microbean.construct.Domain;
035
036import static java.lang.constant.ConstantDescs.BSM_INVOKE;
037import static java.lang.constant.ConstantDescs.CD_Collection;
038import static java.lang.constant.ConstantDescs.CD_boolean;
039import static java.lang.constant.ConstantDescs.CD_int;
040import static java.lang.constant.ConstantDescs.FALSE;
041import static java.lang.constant.ConstantDescs.TRUE;
042
043import static java.lang.constant.DirectMethodHandleDesc.Kind.STATIC;
044import static java.lang.constant.DirectMethodHandleDesc.Kind.VIRTUAL;
045
046import static java.util.Objects.requireNonNull;
047
048/**
049 * An immutable {@link AbstractList} of {@link TypeMirror}s that contains only {@linkplain
050 * BeanTypes#legalBeanType(TypeMirror) legal bean types}, sorted in a specific manner.
051 *
052 * <p><strong>Note:</strong> Two {@link TypeMirror} instances may represent the {@linkplain
053 * org.microbean.construct.Domain#sameType(TypeMirror, TypeMirror) same type} while not being {@linkplain
054 * TypeMirror#equals(Object) equal to} one another. {@link List} implementations such as this one that contain {@link
055 * TypeMirror} elements may also represent the same types without being equal to each other.</p>
056 *
057 * @author <a href="https://about.me/lairdnelson" target="_top">Laird Nelson</a>
058 *
059 * @see BeanTypes#beanTypes(TypeMirror)
060 *
061 * @see TypeMirror#equals(Object)
062 *
063 * @see org.microbean.construct.Domain#sameType(TypeMirror, TypeMirror)
064 */
065public final class BeanTypeList extends AbstractList<TypeMirror> implements Constable {
066
067  private static final BeanTypeList EMPTY_LIST = new BeanTypeList();
068
069  private final BeanTypes beanTypes; // needed only for Constable purposes. This is dumb.
070  
071  private final List<TypeMirror> types;
072
073  private final int interfaceIndex;
074
075  private final boolean proxiable;
076
077  private BeanTypeList() {
078    this.beanTypes = null;
079    this.types = List.of();
080    this.interfaceIndex = -1;
081    this.proxiable = false;
082  }
083
084  private BeanTypeList(final BeanTypes beanTypes,
085                       final Collection<? extends TypeMirror> types,
086                       final int interfaceIndex,
087                       final boolean proxiable) {
088    super();
089    this.beanTypes = requireNonNull(beanTypes, "beanTypes");
090    if (types.isEmpty()) {
091      this.types = List.of();
092      this.interfaceIndex = -1;
093      this.proxiable = proxiable;
094    } else if (types instanceof BeanTypeList btl) {
095      this.types = btl;
096      this.interfaceIndex = btl.interfaceIndex;
097      this.proxiable = btl.proxiable;
098    } else if (types instanceof SupertypeList stl) {
099      this.types = stl;
100      this.interfaceIndex = stl.interfaceIndex();
101      this.proxiable = proxiable;
102    } else {
103      this.types = List.copyOf(types);
104      this.interfaceIndex = interfaceIndex;
105      this.proxiable = proxiable;
106    }
107  }
108
109  @Override // Constable
110  public final Optional<? extends ConstantDesc> describeConstable() {
111    if (this.beanTypes == null) {
112      assert this.isEmpty();
113      return Optional.of(DynamicConstantDesc.of(BSM_INVOKE,
114                                                MethodHandleDesc.ofMethod(STATIC,
115                                                                          ClassDesc.of(this.getClass().getName()),
116                                                                          "of",
117                                                                          MethodTypeDesc.of(ClassDesc.of(this.getClass().getName())))));
118    }
119    return Constables.describeConstable(this.types)
120      .flatMap(typesDesc -> this.beanTypes.describeConstable()
121               .map(beanTypesDesc -> DynamicConstantDesc.of(BSM_INVOKE,
122                                                            MethodHandleDesc.ofMethod(VIRTUAL,
123                                                                                      ClassDesc.of(this.beanTypes.getClass().getName()),
124                                                                                      "beanTypes",
125                                                                                      MethodTypeDesc.of(ClassDesc.of(this.getClass().getName()),
126                                                                                                        CD_Collection)),
127                                                            beanTypesDesc,
128                                                            typesDesc)));
129  }
130
131  @Override // AbstractList<TypeMirror>
132  public final TypeMirror get(final int index) {
133    return this.types.get(index);
134  }
135
136  /**
137   * Returns a non-{@code null}, immutable {@link List} containing only interface types.
138   *
139   * <p>The returned {@link List} may be {@linkplain List#isEmpty() empty}.</p>
140   *
141   * @return a non-{@code null}, immutable {@link List} containing only interface types
142   */
143  public final List<TypeMirror> interfaces() {
144    final int i = this.interfaceIndex;
145    return i < 0 ? List.of() : this.subList(i, this.size());
146  }
147
148  /**
149   * Returns {@code true} if and only if this {@link BeanTypeList} is <dfn>proxiable</dfn>.
150   *
151   * @return {@code true} if and only if this {@link BeanTypeList} is <dfn>proxiable</dfn>
152   *
153   * @see BeanTypes#proxiableElement(Element)
154   *
155   * @spec https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.0/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.0#unproxyable CDI Specification, version 4.0,
156   * section 2.2.10
157   */
158  public final boolean proxiable() {
159    return this.proxiable;
160  }
161
162  @Override // AbstractList<TypeMirror>
163  public final int size() {
164    return this.types.size();
165  }
166
167
168  /*
169   * Static methods.
170   */
171
172
173  /**
174   * Returns a non-{@code null} {@link BeanTypeList} that {@linkplain #isEmpty() is empty}.
175   *
176   * @return a non-{@code null} {@link BeanTypeList} that {@linkplain #isEmpty() is empty}
177   *
178   * @see BeanTypes#beanTypes(Collection)
179   */
180  public static final BeanTypeList of() {
181    return EMPTY_LIST;
182  }
183
184  static final BeanTypeList of(final BeanTypes beanTypes, final Collection<? extends TypeMirror> types) {
185    return of(beanTypes, types, -1, false);
186  }
187
188  static final BeanTypeList of(final BeanTypes beanTypes, final Collection<? extends TypeMirror> types, final boolean proxiable) {
189    return of(beanTypes, types, -1, proxiable);
190  }
191
192  // Called only by BeanTypes. No validation is performed.
193  static final BeanTypeList of(final BeanTypes beanTypes,
194                               final Collection<? extends TypeMirror> types,
195                               final int interfaceIndex,
196                               final boolean proxiable) {
197    return switch (types) {
198    case null -> throw new NullPointerException("types");
199    case Collection<?> c when c.isEmpty() -> EMPTY_LIST;
200    case BeanTypeList btl -> btl;
201    case SupertypeList stl -> new BeanTypeList(beanTypes, stl, stl.interfaceIndex(), proxiable);
202    default -> new BeanTypeList(beanTypes, types, interfaceIndex, proxiable);
203    };
204  }
205
206}
